title: Leadping API Vocabulary
description: Controlled terms used across Leadping's API contracts, documentation, events, and agent integrations.

terms.label: Organization
terms.description: A tenant that owns Leadping users, leads, sources, conversations, automations, and billing resources.

terms.label: Lead
terms.description: A prospective customer and the contact, source, consent, status, and engagement information associated with that prospect.

terms.label: Source
terms.description: An authenticated intake origin through which external systems submit leads to an organization.

terms.label: Conversation
terms.description: The communication history connecting a lead and an organization across supported channels.

terms.label: Message
terms.description: An inbound or outbound communication item associated with a conversation.

terms.label: Call
terms.description: A voice communication session associated with an organization, lead, and conversation.

terms.label: Automation
terms.description: A configured workflow that evaluates triggers and performs follow-up actions.

terms.label: Event
terms.description: A durable record of a business or communication occurrence within Leadping.

terms.label: Webhook
terms.description: A signed HTTPS delivery that notifies an external consumer about a Leadping event.

terms.label: MCP Server
terms.description: Leadping's authenticated Model Context Protocol tool surface for AI agents.

terms.label: Organization API Key
terms.description: A credential granting scoped access to an organization's API resources.

terms.label: Source Key
terms.description: A credential scoped to submitting leads through a specific intake source.

terms.label: OAuth Access Token
terms.description: A scoped bearer token issued for access to protected Leadping resources.

terms.label: SMS
terms.description: Short Message Service communication sent or received through Leadping.

terms.label: Voice
terms.description: Telephone calling communication initiated, received, or recorded through Leadping.

terms.label: Idempotency Key
terms.description: A caller-supplied identifier used to make a retried mutation safe from duplicate execution.

terms.label: Rate Limit
terms.description: A request quota applied to a caller, organization, source, user, or network address.

terms.label: Consent
terms.description: Evidence and permissions governing whether and how a lead may be contacted.
